title: Daily Life - I Can See Clearly Now

segments.en: Well, hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 好吧，大家好，欢迎来到 Englishpod。

segments.en: So, Marco, how are you doing today?
segments.zh: 那么，马可，你今天过得怎么样？

segments.en: I'm doing great and I'm really looking forward to our lesson because we're going to the eye doctor today.
segments.zh: 我做得很好，我真的很期待我们的课程，因为我们今天要去看眼科医生。

segments.en: Okay, so we've got an elementary lesson about going to the eye doctor.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们有一个关于去看眼科医生的基本课程。

segments.en: Well, let's get started then with our vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 好吧，让我们开始我们的词汇预览。

segments.en: We have three words today in our vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 今天我们在词汇预览中有三个词。

segments.en: All three words come from our dialogue.
segments.zh: 这三个词都来自我们的对话。
我们的第一个词是斗争。

segments.en: So, Marco, when I struggle to do something, what does that mean?
segments.zh: 所以，马可，当我努力做某事时，这是什么意思？

segments.en: It means that you have a hard time so you can't really do it very quickly.
segments.zh: 这意味着你很难过，所以你不能很快做到这一点。

segments.en: So you have to try really hard.
You have to try really hard.
Yeah, to do something that's difficult.
segments.zh: 是的，做一些困难的事情。

segments.en: Okay, our next word is blurry.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们的下一个词是模糊的。

segments.en: Whenever something is blurry, you can't really see it well.
segments.zh: 每当有东西模糊时，你就无法真正看到它。

segments.en: Okay, and our final word is prescription.
segments.zh: 好的，我们的最后一句话是处方。

segments.en: Often, when you go to the doctor and you need some medicine, he writes out a prescription.
segments.zh: 通常，当您去看医生并需要一些药物时，他会开出处方。

segments.en: It's like a paper that says all the medicine that you need and then you can go to the drug store and buy it.
segments.zh: 它就像一张纸，上面写着你需要的所有药物，然后你可以去药店买。

segments.en: Okay, so those three words you'll hear in today's dialogue and I think it's time we listen to the dialogue.
segments.zh: 好的，所以你会在今天的对话中听到的这三个词，我想是时候听对话了。

segments.en: What seems to be the problem?
Well, I think I might need glasses.
segments.zh: 我想我可能需要配眼镜了。

segments.en: I'm getting headaches and I really struggle to see things that are far away.
segments.zh: 我最近老是头痛，看远处的东西也很费劲。

segments.en: Sounds like you might be farsighted.
Okay, then cover your left eye and read the chart in front of you.
segments.zh: 好，遮住左眼，读一下前面的视力表。

segments.en: And I can't quite make out the other symbol, but I think it's the peace sign.
segments.zh: 另一个符号我看不太清，好像是和平标志。

segments.en: Wow, Arthur, you're as blind as a bat.
segments.zh: 哇，亚瑟，你这眼神也太差了。

segments.en: My vision is really blurry at times.
segments.zh: 我的视力有时候模糊得很。

segments.en: Head over to the other room and pick out some frames while I fill out your prescription.
segments.zh: 我给你开处方，你去隔壁房间挑副镜框吧。

segments.en: Well, this guy really has poor vision, hey?
segments.zh: 嗯，这家伙的视力真的很差，嘿？

segments.en: I've walked into the bathroom, the men's bathroom, actually, instead of the women's bathroom and that's not because I wasn't wearing my glasses.
segments.zh: 实际上，我走进了浴室，男人的浴室，而不是女人的浴室，那不是因为我没有戴眼镜。

segments.en: It's because you weren't paying attention.
Okay, let's take a look today at our language takeaway.
segments.zh: 好吧，让我们今天来看看我们的语言外卖。

segments.en: The first word on our language takeaway for today is 20-20 vision.
segments.zh: 今天我们语言要点的第一个词是 20-20 愿景。

segments.en: It means that you have perfect vision.
segments.zh: 这意味着你有完美的视野。

segments.en: So I usually wear glasses as well.
But yeah, people that have 20-20 vision don't need glasses.
segments.zh: 但是，是的，视力为 20-20 的人不需要眼镜。

segments.en: So, if I'm far-sighted, I can't see very well, right?
segments.zh: 所以，如果我有远见，我看不清楚，对吧？

segments.en: So if you're far-sighted, you can't see things that are near.
segments.zh: 所以如果你有远见，你看不到附近的东西。

segments.en: So you can see things that are far away, but things that are close are blurry.
segments.zh: 所以你可以看到很远的东西，但很近的东西是模糊的。

segments.en: You can see things that are close well.
segments.zh: 你可以看到非常接近的东西。

segments.en: So our next word is make out.
segments.zh: 所以我们的下一个词是制作出来。

segments.en: That's kind of a funny little phrase.
segments.zh: 这是一个有趣的小短语。

segments.en: And let's listen to a few examples of this phrase so we can understand how it's used.
segments.zh: 让我们听听这个短语的一些例子，这样我们就可以理解它是如何使用的。

segments.en: I can't make out what this says.
segments.zh: 我不明白这是怎么回事。

segments.en: If you look carefully, you can almost make out a few of the stars in the sky.
segments.zh: 如果你仔细看，你几乎可以辨认出天空中的几颗星星。

segments.en: Can you see what's written on the sign there?
segments.zh: 你能看到标志上写的是什么吗？

segments.en: I can't quite make it out.
So basically, make out is to see clearly.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，制作就是看清楚。

segments.en: And our last word for language takeaway today is blind as a bat.
segments.zh: 而我们今天对外卖的最后一个词是盲目。

segments.en: So this is a really funny sounding expression.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常有趣的表达方式。

segments.en: One of these weird English idioms.
segments.zh: 这些奇怪的英语习语之一。

segments.en: It's a really common expression that just means that you can't see.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常常见的表达方式，只是意味着你看不到。

segments.en: So it's not like you actually are blind, right?
segments.zh: 所以这不像你真的是盲人，对吧？

segments.en: But you just really can't see very well.
segments.zh: 但你真的不能很好地看到。

segments.en: We saw four great words today in our language takeaway.
segments.zh: 今天我们在我们的语言收获中看到了四个很棒的词。

segments.en: Now I think we can listen to our dialogue another time.
segments.zh: 现在我想我们可以再听一次我们的对话了。

segments.en: But this time, it's going to be slower so we can pick up all these great words that we just talked about.
segments.zh: 但这一次，它会更慢，这样我们就可以学到我们刚刚谈到的所有这些伟大的词。

segments.en: What seems to be the problem?
Well, I think I might need glasses.
segments.zh: 我想我可能需要配眼镜了。

segments.en: I'm getting headaches and I really struggle to see things that are far away.
segments.zh: 我最近老是头痛，看远处的东西也很费劲。

segments.en: Sounds like you may be farsighted.
segments.zh: 听起来你可能是远视的。

segments.en: Cover your left eye and read the chart in front of you.
segments.zh: 遮住你的左眼并阅读你面前的图表。

segments.en: X, E, R, 3, question mark, and I can't quite make out the other symbol, but I think it's a peace sign.
segments.zh: x, e, r, 3, 问号，我不能完全辨认出另一个符号，但我认为这是一个和平标志。

segments.en: Wow, Arthur, you're as blind as a bat.
segments.zh: 哇，亚瑟，你这眼神也太差了。

segments.en: My vision is really blurry at times.
segments.zh: 我的视力有时候模糊得很。

segments.en: Head on over to the other room and pick out some frames while I fill out your prescription.
segments.zh: 在我填写您的处方时，前往另一个房间并挑选一些相框。

segments.en: And with this, we can start now with putting it together.
segments.zh: 有了这个，我们现在可以从把它放在一起开始。

segments.en: So we saw a couple of useful phrases in this dialogue, and I think we can show you how to use these phrases in a few different ways.
segments.zh: 所以我们在这个对话中看到了一些有用的短语，我认为我们可以向您展示如何以几种不同的方式使用这些短语。

segments.en: The first one that we have today is, what seems to be.
segments.zh: 我们今天拥有的第一个是，似乎是。

segments.en: So we heard in the dialogue, the doctor said, what seems to be the problem.
segments.zh: 所以我们在对话中听到了，医生说，似乎有什么问题。

segments.en: We can use this same expression in a number of different ways.
segments.zh: 我们可以通过多种不同的方式使用相同的表达式。

segments.en: What seems to be the problem?
What seems to be the matter?
What seems to be the trouble?
Okay, so with these examples, we can see how we can use the phrase, what seems to be, in many different ways.
segments.zh: 好吧，通过这些例子，我们可以看到我们如何以许多不同的方式使用这个短语，似乎是什么。

segments.en: Yeah, it's a great way of asking, what's the problem?
segments.zh: 是的，这是一个很好的询问方式，有什么问题？

segments.en: So now, let's take a look at another phrase.
segments.zh: 所以现在，让我们来看看另一个短语。

segments.en: We heard in the dialogue, the doctor said, head on over to the other room.
segments.zh: 医生说，我们在对话中听到了，前往另一个房间。

segments.en: And with this phrase, head on, we can combine it with other prepositions to indicate another place.
segments.zh: 有了这个短语，我们可以将它与其他介词结合起来以指示另一个地方。

segments.en: Okay, so for example, we can say, head on into the house, it's gonna rain soon.
segments.zh: 好吧，例如，我们可以说，走进房子，很快就会下雨。

segments.en: Or we can say, hey guys, let's head on out to the park.
segments.zh: 或者我们可以说，嘿伙计们，让我们去公园吧。

segments.en: Or I can also say, head on up to my room, I'll be there in a second.
segments.zh: 或者我也可以说，前往我的房间，我一会儿就到。
这些是一些很酷的短语。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to our dialogue and maybe we'll hear them again.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不听我们的对话，也许我们会再次听到他们的声音。

segments.en: Okay, so talking about going to the eye doctor today, I have a question for our listeners.
segments.zh: 好的，所以说到今天去看眼科医生，我有一个问题要问我们的听众。
对我们的听众来说是一个挑战。

segments.en: What's it called when you can't distinguish colors?
segments.zh: 当你无法区分颜色时，它叫什么？

segments.en: So like when you can't tell the difference between red and blue and green.
segments.zh: 所以就像你无法区分红色、蓝色和绿色的时候一样。

segments.en: So what is that condition called?
So there's like a technical term.
So we'll be looking for it on our comments page and be sure to, if you know the answer, post it.
segments.zh: 所以我们会在我们的评论页面上寻找它，如果你知道答案，请发布它。

segments.en: Also, if you have questions about today's lesson or any other lesson, please come and visit our website and ask us.
segments.zh: 另外，如果您对今天的课程或任何其他课程有任何疑问，请访问我们的网站并询问我们。

segments.en: Yeah, we hope to see you there, but until then it's goodbye.
segments.zh: 是的，我们希望在那里见到你，但在那之前是再见。
